name: PostHog
description: PostHog lets agents query events and funnels, inspect feature flags, and summarize what changed after a release. Each user signs in to their own PostHog account through the browser.

prompts.text: How does the signup funnel look for the last 14 days?
Which feature flags are enabled for this user?
Did activation change after last week's release?

apps.name: PostHog
apps.description: Event, funnel, and feature-flag access, over PostHog's MCP server with browser sign-in.
